exercises.name: March in place
exercises.instructions: Stand near support. March slowly, swing arms comfortably. Stop if dizzy.

exercises.name: Tandem stance
exercises.instructions: Stand near a wall/counter. Place one foot in front of the other, hold 10–30s. Repeat 2–3 times.

exercises.name: Sit-to-stand
exercises.instructions: From a chair, stand up slowly then sit down with control. Use arms if needed.

exercises.name: Foot sensory re-education
exercises.instructions: Seated. Use a towel/soft ball. Roll under foot, then gently tap different textures. Focus on sensation.

exercises.name: Finger taps (nine-tap)
exercises.instructions: Tap 9 targets once each. Focus on accuracy. Rest 30–60s between sets.

exercises.name: Easy walk
exercises.instructions: Walk at comfortable pace. Use support if needed. RPE 3–5.

exercises.name: Calf stretch
exercises.instructions: Hold 20–30s each side. Do not bounce.
